lines:
Narrow UI edit commands for C4 element facts, relationship facts, and simple relationship creation.

Approved Markdown extension (implementation pending): Add narrow Tauri commands and dashboard models for listing/opening/creating/updating/deleting/importing Markdown design documents and editing their associations through ProjectStore and the shared transaction boundary. Reuse canonical snapshot readTokens rather than a separate UI-only version scheme. Support coherent title/body/link edits, explicit reference detachment and backend conflict errors. No desktop command writes generated Markdown as authoritative content or opens raw driver connections. Cross-client updates refresh clean content while preserving dirty drafts; stale saves surface the current canonical document for user reconciliation. Trigger/report derived output refresh after canonical commits without misreporting commit success.
